name: InterContinental Beijing Sanlitun
insider_take: This sleek tower rises above Beijing's hippest district, where diplomatic quarter meets trendy nightlife scene.
whats_special: Located in the heart of Sanlitun, Beijing's premier entertainment and shopping district, this modern hotel sits steps from the famous Sanlitun Bar Street and is surrounded by embassies from over 100 countries. The area transforms from business hub by day to vibrant nightlife destination after dark, offering an authentic taste of contemporary Beijing culture.
pro_tip: Book a higher floor room facing south for stunning views of the Workers' Stadium, especially spectacular during evening events and concerts.
dont_miss: Explore the iconic Sanlitun Village shopping complex directly across the street, featuring international brands and local designers. Walk to nearby Ritan Park (Temple of the Sun) for morning tai chi sessions with locals, or experience Beijing's craft beer revolution at the numerous microbreweries within a 5-minute walk.
pros: Prime location in the heart of Sanlitun, Beijing's trendiest diplomatic and entertainment district
Sophisticated, contemporary rooms and suites with stunning city skyline views
World-class dining options featuring both authentic Chinese cuisine and international fare
Exceptional Club InterContinental lounge with exclusive perks and personalized service
Seamless access to top Beijing attractions, embassies, luxury shopping, and vibrant nightlife
cons: Premium urban pricing may not suit budget-conscious travelers
Bustling Sanlitun neighborhood can feel lively and fast-paced for guests seeking a quieter retreat
